paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.36% on average, with S&P 500 strongest (+0.54%) and Euro Stoxx 50 weakest (-0.81%). Brent crude changed -3.56% to 98.94. Gold changed +0.27% to 4,190.7998. Bitcoin changed +0.77% to 84,265.1562. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.291%, a relative move of +0.69%. Among the firms tracked, US Oil Fund (ETF) (+2.54%) and BBVA (-2.02%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: FirstFT: Anthropic IPO filing warns of ‘existential risks’ (FT Companies). Also in today’s newsletter: oil bonds link and Rubio says ‘foreign actor’ behind UK terror plot Deals and capital markets: Fintech Zilch taps banks for IPO next year (FT Markets). UK consumer credit company has invited advisers to pitch on a planned listing in London Central banks and macro: ECB ‘cannot wait’ for high energy prices to fuel wider inflation, top policymaker warns (FT World). Isabel Schnabel calls for pre-emptive action as price growth accelerates faster than expected in Eurozone’s biggest economies Central banks and macro: A warning of ‘breakdowns and deficiencies’ in security at the US central bank (FT World). Also in today’s newsletter, Marco Rubio blames ‘foreign actor’ for UK terror plot and US completes Iraqi troop withdrawal Geopolitics and trade: Middle Eastern oil exports rise to highest level since Iran war began (FT Markets). Shuttle services through Strait of Hormuz have brought shipments to more than 80% of prewar daily average
